conditions: 仅断言公开记录中的 2023 MemGPT virtual-context architecture 早于 2025 MemoryOS three-tier/four-module architecture；不据此声称作者影响或直接继承。
A-MEM 处理 linked-note organization/evolution；MemTxn 处理 source-supported admission、temporal visibility 与 recovery。complements 是报告架构推断，不是双方声明的集成。
bitemporal representation 保存 identity/version 与 valid/transaction time；MemTxn 增加 admission/journal/recovery。关系限于机制互补，不表示兼容实现。
复现论文明确以 fixed constructed LightMem store 比较 retriever，并将结论限制在其 matched-depth/token-budget protocol；不外推到所有版本或全部 memory systems。
官方 repository 链接同名论文并暴露 ChromaDB、MCP、playground、PyPI、eval 目录；implements 不表示本次已执行或复现论文结果。
官方 MemP code documents ProcedureMem and offline/online paths matching the paper's build/retrieve/update mechanism；本次未执行。
Mem2ActBench 覆盖 remembered constraints→tool selection/parameter grounding；MemoryArena 覆盖 interdependent environment action/feedback loop。关系表示 protocol coverage 互补，不允许合并分数。
WorldLines 暴露 partial observability/overwritten state/planning failure；MeMento/DunphyBench 检查 preference-conditioned multimodal compression。两者任务和数字不可排名。
AgentPoison artifact/paper supplies a poisoning mechanism lane；MemSecBench supplies a distinct Write–Execute–Forget lifecycle protocol。无作者影响或同一 harness 主张。
MutMem addresses authorized/traceable mutation but disclaims truth；STALE/StateAuditor distinguishes provenance/chronology from semantic supersession。关系表示 assurance gaps 互补。
Cognee documents graph/vector/ontology infrastructure；HippoRAG documents knowledge-graph plus Personalized PageRank retrieval。关系限于 architecture layers，不声称直接 integration 或 performance ordering。
AtomMem focuses atomic facts→events/profiles/associative graph；bitemporal store focuses identity/version/valid+transaction time。关系是 representation dimensions 互补，不表示合并系统。
当前 README 自述 formerly MemGPT 且该 repository 是 legacy Letta V1 server、active work moved；关系不把当前 repo 状态等同于 paper-era architecture。
MemoryBank's store/retriever/updater source predates MemoryOS; no author-asserted project influence was verified.
Voyager's executable-skill source predates MemP's instruction/script source; this does not establish citation or causal influence.
MemoryAgentBench's dated source predates Memora's dated source; protocols are not numerically comparable.
Memory Gym is an earlier partially observable endless-task boundary benchmark; WorldLines is a later LLM embodied-state benchmark. No direct influence is asserted.
The ACL memory-extraction event predates DP-MemView's repeated-response privacy-interface event; no direct influence claim.
The query-only MINJA source predates MAFIA; MAFIA additionally assumes benign-memory pools and active input auditing. This is not an influence claim.
Report-level architecture comparison only: tier movement/control flow versus learned selection over memory operations; no source-asserted lineage.
MemoryOS names storage/updating/retrieval/generation; MemTxn adds source-supported admission, temporal selection, and snapshot recovery. No author-asserted lineage.
Prediction holds only if learned operation choice is constrained by separately auditable admission, version, delete, and recovery primitives; independent matched tests are required.
Bitemporal version semantics and signed predecessor-linked mutation provenance address different parts of update history; neither establishes content truth.
Trustworthy retrieval and guarded write admission occupy different lifecycle points; the inspected evidence does not test the combined system.
Mem2ActBench measures tool selection/parameter grounding; MemoryArena measures later decisions in interdependent tasks. Scores remain non-comparable.
MemoryAgentBench covers incremental competencies; MemSecBench covers adversarial write-execute-forget. Metrics and threat assumptions differ.
AriGraph supplies a semantic/episodic world-model mechanism; WorldLines exposes partial-observability, overwritten-state, and plan-translation failures. No shared matched evaluation was inspected.
POLAR separates personalized semantic/visual context from episodes; MeMento studies preference-conditioned fixed-token compression. Their protocols are not rankable.
MemP evolves remembered procedures; MemSkill evolves the policy that constructs and manages memory. No common independent benchmark was inspected.

Prediction requires a full-chain implementation that combines selected public response views with write policy, provenance, rollback, logs, and action authorization; neither source validates the combination.
Prediction requires intent-specific temporal candidate generation followed by scope/provenance/trust filtering under a fixed retrieval budget; the sources do not evaluate the joint system.
